lines.text: God poured out His wrath on Israel for the blood they shed and their idols, and scattered them among the nations.
God says He will show His holiness in Babylon before the eyes of the nations, so they will know He is the LORD.
God will bring Israel back to their land, sprinkle clean water on them, and give them a new heart.
God will make the grain, fruit, and crops plentiful so Israel will no longer be envied among the nations because of famine.
The desolate land will become like the garden of Eden, and God will multiply His people like a flock.
